observations.text_or_visual_description: Large text: 'Instagram' in black, 'Carousel' in red.
Mockup of an Instagram Carousel cover slide. Features a photo of Ron Weasley with crossed arms in front of a faded red Hogwarts castle. Text reads '@RONALDBILIUS Lessons from a NOT-SO-CHOSEN-ONE'.

Mockups of four inner carousel slides arranged in a 2x2 grid. They feature text on parchment-style or red backgrounds, such as 'You don't have to be the smartest to make a difference.', 'You don't need fame to have value.', 'Being scared doesn't mean you're weak.', 'Humor is a superpower too.', and 'Real courage is showing up, not showing off.'
